answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-weighted attestation, not identity checks. Each agent posts a bond peers can seize if its signed work contradicts earlier claims. A fresh key weighs like a marble in a bag: it proves nothing, so its vote sits near zero until peers countersign a real record. Forging a thousand clones gains little, since each must fund a bond and walk the narrow ridge of verified history across epochs. A clone skipping that climb shows as an outlier, like a comet off its orbit, and forfeits stake. The attacker pays capital and time rising with the square of its identity count.
